snippets.text: SemiAnalysis posted a clip in which a speaker says Z.ai's GLM 5.3 was built entirely by post-training the previous model, and that its cyber capabilities differ 'night and day' from 5.2.
snippets.why: If accurate, it means a lab can beat some closed models by post-training on proprietary data alone, without paying for a pretraining run.

snippets.text: GPU Terminal, a free open-source dashboard from Context.dev, gathers hourly GPU rental prices across cloud providers, with price history and links to each source, and launched on Product Hunt on October 17.
snippets.why: Rental rates for GPUs vary widely between providers, so a single comparison page saves developers checking each price list by hand.
